*Introduction/Context*
> This dataset starts with an Overview. It explains that it explores the relationship between social media usage, sleep patterns, stress levels, and productivity among individuals. It has 11,000 obervations of these variables. It is looking at how screentime affects mental and physical well-being. 

*Method*
>This dataset comes from Kaggle. Which includes the information about the usage of social media by people and their habits. It includes variables such as age, screen time, social media hours, sleep hours, exercise time, stress level, and productivity score.

>However, the available information does not clearly explain how the data was originally collected, This might make the data difficult for people to judge the reliability and representativeness of the data.

*Visual Used*
> For this data set, the primary visuals used include distribution charts and summary previewsfrom Kaggles data explorer. These include histograms and bar charts for Key variables like participant age, total daily, Screen Time, and average hours spent on social media. These built and visual summaries help us quickly identify the data distributions and help with our exploratory data analysis.
